ev.q: finding longitude amounts to knowing the time at a reference point, such as the home port, at the same moment as the local time on board ship

1.why: A段。B depended on knowing the time in two places at once ↔ knowing the time at a reference point … at the same moment as the local time on board ship。A 弄反了：用太阳或北极星测的是纬度；D 也是纬度的测法（height of the sun at noon）；C 文中未提。

ev.q: many of its members expected the answer to come from astronomy rather than from clockmaking

2.why: B段末句。D Many of its members expected an astronomical answer ↔ many of its members expected the answer to come from astronomy。A 错在 immediately：触礁是 1707 年，法案和评审机构在七年后（1714）；B 与原文相反（期待天文学而非钟表）；C 文中没有这种限制。

ev.q: The method did not become practical until 1766, when the astronomer Nevil Maskelyne published the first Nautical Almanac, which gave the necessary predictions in advance.

3.why: C段末句。A the required predictions were published in advance ↔ published the first Nautical Almanac, which gave the necessary predictions in advance；did not become practical until ↔ became practical only when。B、C 都是该方法的要求（precise instruments、四小时计算），但不是“直到……才可行”的那个转折点。

ev.q: Some members argued that the result might have been due to luck, others that a single watch proved nothing unless more could be made to the same standard

4.why: E段。C doubted that the result could be repeated ↔ might have been due to luck / a single watch proved nothing unless more could be made to the same standard。A 与原文相反（far within the limit set by the Act）；B 颠倒：是评审要求他公开结构，并非他拒绝；D 文中没有此事。

ev.q: in place of a pendulum, which would have been thrown off by the rolling of the ship, it used two linked balances connected by springs

5.why: D段。design feature intended to cope with the movement of a ship ↔ in place of a pendulum, which would have been thrown off by the rolling of the ship, it used two linked balances。A段末也说钟表在海上 thrown about by the waves，但那是说明问题，不是设计上的应对。

ev.q: offered a reward of £20,000, a fortune at the time, for a method that could determine longitude to within half a degree

6.why: B段。the size of a reward offered by law ↔ the Longitude Act, which offered a reward of £20,000。F段的 £8,750 是议会后来给 Harrison 的拨款，不是法律悬赏的奖金，是近似干扰。

ev.q: Because the Earth turns through 15 degrees every hour, finding longitude amounts to knowing the time at a reference point

7.why: A段。the Earth's rotation ↔ the Earth turns through 15 degrees every hour；relates to finding a position ↔ finding longitude amounts to knowing the time…。C段讲月亮在星空背景下移动，不是地球自转。

ev.q: Captain James Cook took a copy of H4, made by the watchmaker Larcum Kendall, on his second voyage to the Pacific

8.why: F段。someone who took a copy of a timekeeper on a voyage ↔ Captain James Cook took a copy of H4 … on his second voyage。E段的牙买加航行用的是 H4 原件，不是复制品。

ev.q: calculations that could take an experienced navigator up to four hours

9.why: C段。how long a calculation could take ↔ calculations that could take … up to four hours。D段的 twenty-five years 是 Harrison 造钟花的时间，不是计算所需时间。

ev.q: H4, finished in 1759, looked like an oversized pocket watch, only 13 centimetres across

10.why: E段。appearance: like a large ↔ looked like an oversized。不要填 13 centimetres（那是尺寸，不是外观像什么）。

ev.q: On a voyage from Portsmouth to Jamaica that lasted 81 days

11.why: E段。trial voyage to the Caribbean ↔ a voyage from Portsmouth to Jamaica；lasted ↔ lasted 81 days。five seconds 是误差，1761 to 1762 是年份，都是同句干扰。

12.why: F段。sum finally granted by Parliament in 1773 ↔ in 1773 … Parliament awarded him £8,750。£20,000 是B段法案悬赏的总额，Harrison 从未领到全额。

ev.q: Captain James Cook took a copy of H4, made by the watchmaker Larcum Kendall

13.why: F段。the copy … was the work of ↔ a copy of H4, made by the watchmaker Larcum Kendall。不要填 John Harrison：H4 原件是他做的，但 Cook 带的复制品出自 Kendall 之手。
